Name: T01
Title: Data Integrity Module 1
Body:
Welcome, {EMP}! This short module keeps our data, and you, intact.

Estimated time: 3 minutes.
Estimated time: forever.

Name: T02
Title: What is a Signature?
Body: Every HALCYON key has a SIGNATURE: a row of glyphs, each one LIT or UNLIT.

Name: T03
Title: Fragments
Body:
Keys are assembled from FRAGMENTS. Each fragment is also a row of glyphs.

You may switch fragments ON or OFF.

Name: T04
Title: The Integrity Rule
Body:
Look down each column of glyphs.

If an ODD number of your active fragments are lit there, the result is LIT.
If an EVEN number are lit (or none), the result is UNLIT.

Name: T05
Title: Practice
Body:
Combine fragments until your RESULT matches the SIGNATURE.
The result is shown live for this module only.

Name: T06
Title: Well Done!
Body:
Integrity confirmed. Future keys will not show you the signature.
You will have to find it.

It is written all around you.

Name: T07
Title: Quick Check
Body: Malware may disguise itself as a fragment. What should you do?
Options: Trust every fragment|Report it to your manager|Look closer

Name: T08
Title: Final Question
Body: Do you consent to your next take?
